RESULT [continual]: CIFAR100 with 10 tasks: MagMax 80.41%, plain weight averaging 77.04%, EWC 76.24%, LwF 73.45%, sequential fine-tuning about 73%. On ImageNet-R with 10 tasks, averaging reaches 81.87% vs MagMax 83.33%. On DomainNet, LwF (69.67% domain-incremental) is slightly above MagMax (69.00%).
US [continual]: If each harvested increment is trained as its own task vector against a fixed anchor, a bad increment can be dropped from the merge without retraining, which is exactly the professor's rollback. It also shows that plain weight averaging comes close. Evidence is from ViT classifiers; it has not been shown on YOLO detection.
